M.shape: 3-component vector per local field state: (Mx, My, Mz)

A.shape: 3-component vector per local field state: (Ax, Ay, Az)

Psi.shape: 6-component local state: (Mx, My, Mz, Ax, Ay, Az)
Psi.notes: This is the least-assumptive software composition of M in R3 and A in R3.

S.meaning: Sensitivity matrix mapping external perturbations to manifold response

T_total.shape: square rank-2 tensor or spatial tensor field

Phi_ejected.meaning: Preserved structural information ejected after phase lock
Phi_ejected.shape: same information content as source structural state

Omega_T.notes: Meaning supplied; numerical units and operational formula remain unresolved.

DEF-M6-001.title: Six-component local manifold state
DEF-M6-001.mathematical_form: Psi = (Mx, My, Mz, Ax, Ay, Az)
DEF-M6-001.description: A local manifold state couples a three-component compressive field and a three-component repulsive field.
software_contract: M must contain exactly three finite numerical components.
A must contain exactly three finite numerical components.
Psi must preserve component order and values.

AX-GRAD-001.title: Gradient autonomy
AX-GRAD-001.description: Propagation is determined by the local compressive-field gradient rather than particle identity or hardcoded trajectories.
software_contract: Propagation direction must be computed from the supplied gradient.
No branch may select direction from matter/antimatter labels.
unresolved_items: Exact spatial embedding of the third axis in an 8 x 8 representation.
AX-GRAD-001.source_section: 1.1 Mathematical Formulation of the Gradient Field

INV-DUAL-001.title: Absolute conservation of field duality
INV-DUAL-001.description: Changes in compressive and repulsive fields must be equal and opposite.
software_contract: The update must preserve dM + dA = 0 within tolerance.
No field information may be silently discarded.
unresolved_items: Numerical integration scheme beyond an explicit first-order step.

INV-GLOBAL-001.title: Global tensegrity equilibrium
INV-GLOBAL-001.description: The global scalar field balance remains zero.
software_contract: Calculate both scalar and component-wise totals.
Report both interpretations rather than silently choosing one.
unresolved_items: Whether component-wise zero balance is required or only scalar zero balance.

TR-PHASE-001.title: Phase-lock condition
TR-PHASE-001.description: A local cell enters phase lock when compressive and repulsive field states converge.
software_contract: Calculate the residual M - A.
Use a declared tolerance and include it in every audit.

TR-JAM-001.title: Boundary jam
TR-JAM-001.description: A local cell jams when maximum tension and limiting external resistance occur together.
software_contract: Both conditions must pass.
Thresholds must be externally declared and audited.

TR-EJECT-001.title: Non-truncating harmonic ejection
TR-EJECT-001.description: After phase lock, the local coordinate resets while structural information is preserved in an ejected packet.
software_contract: Deep-copy or serialize structural information before reset.
Reset source coordinate only after preservation succeeds.
Audit before-state, packet-state, and after-state hashes.
unresolved_items: Destination and reinsertion rules for the clean-cell pool.

EQ-SENS-001.title: Sensitivity response
EQ-SENS-001.description: External perturbations modify the manifold through a sensitivity matrix.
software_contract: Matrix columns must equal perturbation-vector length.
Preserve units metadata when supplied.
EQ-SENS-001.source_section: Unified ABTM Field Equations, Harmonic Coupling and Sensitivity

TR-BIF-001.title: Bifurcation detection
TR-BIF-001.description: A near-singular sensitivity matrix indicates transition toward a nonlinear regime.
software_contract: S must be square.
Report determinant and threshold together.
TR-BIF-001.source_section: Unified ABTM Field Equations, Harmonic Coupling and Sensitivity

INV-Z6-001.title: Original Z6 trace residue
INV-Z6-001.description: The supplied original engine returns stable when the barrier-matrix trace has zero residue modulo six.
software_contract: Input must be a two-dimensional numerical matrix.
Return stable only when sigma equals zero.
Do not present this rule as equivalent to every broader ABTM invariant.
unresolved_items: Derivation connecting this matrix invariant to the 64-cell M^6 field.

GRID-64-001.title: 64-cell spatial lattice
GRID-64-001.description: The software supports a fixed 64-cell frame while preserving uncertainty about how source observations populate cells.
software_contract: Every cell has a stable coordinate.
Empty and overflow states must be explicit.
Mapping must be audited and never silently rearranged.
unresolved_items: Whether each cell stores one scalar, one subgroup, or one six-component local manifold state.
How the z spatial axis is encoded.

equilibrium_tolerance.name: equilibrium_tolerance
equilibrium_tolerance.meaning: Numerical tolerance for zero-valued conservation residuals
equilibrium_tolerance.source_basis: Software cannot test exact floating-point equality robustly.

phase_lock_tolerance.name: phase_lock_tolerance
phase_lock_tolerance.meaning: Numerical tolerance for ||M - A|| approaching zero
phase_lock_tolerance.source_basis: The manuscript specifies a limit, not a finite software threshold.

dominance_threshold.name: dominance_threshold
dominance_threshold.source_basis: The manuscript uses the qualitative relation 'much greater than'.

resistance_threshold.name: resistance_threshold
resistance_threshold.meaning: Finite software threshold approximating an infinite resistance gradient
resistance_threshold.source_basis: The manuscript states gradient approaches infinity.

tension_capacity.name: tension_capacity
tension_capacity.source_basis: Maximum tension is named but not numerically fixed.

coupling_constant_k.name: coupling_constant_k
coupling_constant_k.source_basis: Equation supplies k but not its value or units.

time_step.name: time_step
time_step.meaning: Discrete integration interval for coupled M/A evolution
time_step.source_basis: Differential equation supplied without a numerical integration interval.

notes: A six-component cell state follows directly from M in R3 and A in R3.
The assignment of raw user sequences to these cell states remains unresolved.
The 8 x 8 display is spatially two-dimensional while gradient equations are three-dimensional.
